podcast.title: Second Black Keys Label
podcast.body: The Black Keys signed with the indie label Fat Possum for their second album, *Thickfreakness*, which was notably funded by Dan Auerbach and Patrick Carney themselves by mowing lawns. "they signed with another indie label called Fat Possum."

podcast.title: Second Black Keys Label
podcast.body: An indie label with whom The Black Keys signed for their second album, *Thickfreakness*, an album that the band initially funded themselves through lawn mowing. "they signed with another indie label called Fat Possum."

podcast.title: The Black Keys' Label
podcast.body: An independent record label that signed The Black Keys, supporting them during their early career when they recorded albums in a rented tire warehouse. "They were recording for a label called Fat Possum."
